title: Roger Goodell says Illinois still has an opportunity to keep the Bears

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Roger Goodell says Illinois still has an opportunity to keep the Bears
sources.description: “We want to make sure that Arlington Heights and Illinois have an opportunity, as well as Indiana, to put their best foot forward," Goodell said.
